title: Hollywood actors box office earnings over time
subtitle: 2000 to 2024
hook: See how cumulative box office earnings shifted across different film genres from 2000 to 2024.
setup: This race tracks the top-performing movie genre combinations over two decades based on recorded earnings.

sequence.text: Adventure, Fantasy debuted at the top of the rankings with 27,607 in earnings.
Drama, Action, Crime, Thriller surged into the lead with 33,108 in earnings.
Action, Science Fiction, Adventure claimed the top spot reaching 36,753.
Adventure, Action, Science Fiction jumped up to fifth place with 29,914 in earnings.

highlights.headline: New Peak Reached
highlights.detail: Action, Science Fiction, Adventure took the lead with a value of 36,753.

factBox.heading: Top Genre
factBox.body: Reached the highest recorded leader value in the dataset.

ending: Over twenty-four years, blockbuster genres continually rotated at the top of the box office race.
